[[Ang the Ephemeral]] seeks to test you by pitting you against 5 [[Shackled Spirit]]s.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
| profession = Ritualist
| primary = y
| secondary = n
}}

===Objectives===
* Speak with Ang again to begin eliminating the shackled spirits.
* Defeat the 5 shackled spirits. You have [5...0] shackled spirit[s] remaining.
* See Ang the Ephemeral for your reward.

===Early benefits===
*Ang the Ephemeral will teach you the following skills when you accept the quest:
**{{skill icon|Generous Was Tsungrai}}
**{{skill icon|Spirit Rift}}

===Reward===
* 1,500 [[Experience]]
* 100 [[Gold]]
* [[Monastery Credit]]

==Walkthrough==
Follow the green markers and open the [[Soul Keepers]], disposing of each spirit before moving on to the next. The spirits are fairly harmless, and Ang will heal you if needed.

==NPCs==
===Foes===
[[Spirit]]s
*{{Rt}} 5 (23) [[Shackled Spirit]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Ang the Ephemeral
''I bound the souls of some bandits into objects years ago so that the [[envoy]]s could collect them. Strangely, they never did, and the shackled souls remain here to this day. We will use them as test subjects for your newly acquired power, but be forewarned that they will show you no mercy if you allow them the upper hand.''

''Please take some time to review the skills I have just given you. When you are ready, speak with me again and we can put these souls to rest.''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I am ready.
| decline = I'm not ready to fight ghosts.
| ask = When you are ready, approach the Soul Keepers and open them. Dispatch the [[Shackled Spirit|shackled spirits]] using your new skills.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Ang the Ephemeral
''You will make a fine Ritualist one day, <Character name>.''
